name: Flaming Chef (CR 15)
body:
FLAMING CHEF
CR 15

Dwarf alchemist (inspired chemist, royal alchemist) 12 / trickster 6
CG Medium humanoid (dwarf)
Init +11 (amazing initiative); Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +2

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 14, flat-footed 15 (+2 armor, +2 natural, +5 Dex)
hp 153 (12d8+72+24)
Fort +12, Ref +13, Will +6; +2 vs. spells and spell-like abilities
Defensive Abilities desert delver, force of will, hard to kill, master of escape, mythic saves, recuperation; Immune poison; Resist cold 1, fire 1

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft. (slow and steady)
Melee +2 flaming battlepot cauldron +11/+6 (1d8+2 +1d6 fire plus injection)
Ranged bomb 19/day +18/+13 (6d6+10 fire, DC 21)
Special Attacks breath weapon 1/day (15 ft. cone, 5d4 fire damage, DC 21), fickle attack, mythic power 15/day, surge +1d8, surprise strike
Alchemist Extracts Prepared (CL 12th)

4th—cure critical wounds, dragon’s breath (DC 19), fire shield, universal formula
3rd—amplify elixir, burrow, cure serious wounds, elemental aura (DC 18), protection from energy
2nd—blistering invective (DC 17), curative distillation, cure moderate wounds, fiery runes, fire breath (DC 17), fire sneeze (DC 17)
1st—bomber’s eye, bouncy body, cure light wounds, firebelly (DC 16), polypurpose panacea, spirit share, targeted bomb admixture

STATISTICS

Str 11, Dex 20, Con 21, Int 21, Wis 15, Cha 10
Base Atk +9; CMB +9; CMD 24 (28 vs. bull rush or trip while standing on the ground)
Traits Focused Burn, Rough and Ready
Feats Breadth of Experience, Brew Potion, Extra Bombs, Healing Potion, Inspired Alchemy, Master Alchemist, Throw Anything, Weapon Focus (bomb)
Skills Appraise +20, Craft (alchemy) +32, Disable Device +20, Escape Artist +17, Heal +17, Knowledge (nature) +19, Profession (cook) +19, Survival +14, Use Magic Device +15
Languages Common, Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, Ignan, Terran, Undercommon
SQ alchemical antidote (11 points), alchemy (alchemy crafting +12, identify potions), assured drinker, discoveries (breath weapon bomb, fast bombs, greater inspiring cognatogen, immolation bomb, infusion, inspired bomb), enduring elixir, greater inspiring cognatogen (11 points, +2 dodge to AC, +2 Ref, -4 Str/Con, amazing inspiration, eidetic recollection, expanded inspiration), path dabbling (remixer), this might just work
Gear alchemist’s fire, alchemist’s kit, alchemist’s lab, alchemist’s suit, ambrosia, amulet of natural armor +2, apron of the careful chemist, Artokus’ fire, +2 flaming battlepot cauldron, belt of mighty constitution +4, celwyinvian stone fruit, cheya dumplings, cooking kit, elixir of fire breath, headband of mental prowess +2 (Int, Wis), hybridization funnel, ifrit‘s blood, incendiary catalyst, liquid courage, stout solution, tangleburn bag, traveler’s any-tool, 10 gp

ABOUT

At the pinnacle of mortal renown, the Flaming Chef commands legendary alchemical mixtures and legendary culinary mastery, combining mythic resilience with an unstoppable arsenal of explosive recipes.
